In [[3954 BBY]], following orders from [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Nyriss]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], along with Nyriss' [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] [[Sechel]] and her [[Chief of Security/Legends|security chief]] [[Murtog]], embarked on a '''mission''' to the [[Bosthirda separatist compound]] in order to eliminate a group of [[Bosthirda separatists|separatists]]. After a vicious battle, the group discovered that the separatists were working with Nyriss' rival [[Darth Xedrix]]. Later, Nyriss ordered Scourge to [[Duel on Bosthirda|eliminate]] the traitor.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The human filth will die, my lord. I will not fail.|Scourge promises to destroy the separatists|<ref name="Revan" />}}
[[File:Bosthirda.png|thumb|left|180px|Bosthirda and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], capital of the Sith Empire]]
In [[3954 BBY]], following [[Assassination attempts on Darth Nyriss|several]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempts on Dark Councilor Darth Nyriss' life, it was discovered that one of the assassins, a reprogrammed serving droid, was created at a [[Uxiol Droid Manufacturing plant|plant]] on [[Hallion]]. She sent Sith Lord Scourge and her advisor Sechel on a [[Mission to Hallion|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to discover who purchased the droid. There, the pair discovered that the droid had been purchased by the Bosthirda separatists. After informing Nyriss of this development, she sent Scourge, Sechel, her security chief [[Murtog]], and several [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to raid a building in [[Jerunga]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bosthirda/Legends|Bosthirda]], which the separatists were using as a base.<ref name="Revan" />

==The raid==
{{Quote|Target is blind. Move in.|Scourge orders Murtog and his soldiers to begin the raid|<ref name="Revan" />}}
After arriving on Bosthirda, the group studied the building, looking for any defenses unknown to them. After finding none, Scourge climbed the building and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|destroy]] the roof-mounted [[Holocamera/Legends|cams]]. Shortly after, he ordered Murtog and his team to move in. They complied, using [[Flash grenade/Legends|flash]] and [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun]] [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] along with suppressive fire to attack the separatists. As the separatists returned fire on Murtog's team, Scourge was attacked by a pair of [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]].<ref name="Revan" />

Scourge used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to [[Death/Legends|slaughter]] the first [[Unidentified Bosthirda separatist sniper|one]], and then proceeded to pick up the [[Unidentified Bosthirda separatist sniper 2|second]] one by his collar, throwing him off the roof. He then entered the building and proceeded to kill twenty separatists that were caught off-guard by the attack. Scourge then [[Cho mok/Legends|cut off]] the [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] of a few separatists while [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitating]] others, and then used the Force and his lightsaber to kill the rest. After a few [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], the raid was over, as all the separatists were dead. Only three or four of Murtog's team died in the battle.<ref name="Revan" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Lord_Scourge_Valiant.png|thumb|right|200px|Scourge]]
{{Dialogue|Scourge|What did you find?|Sechel|A recording of a recent communication.|Scourge|Darth Xedrix.|Sechel|Most of the call had already been erased by the cleaner program. But I was able to save this.|Darth Xedrix|...latest attempt failed...Nyriss is dangerous, and must not be...keep allegiances hidden...stop the Emperor...madness must end...|Scourge|Can you get anything more?|Sechel|Not here. Give me enough time and the proper equipment and I should be able to come up with plenty.|Scourge|Tell you team to load up every terminal and datafile they find. Nyriss won't be pleased if we leave something important behind.|attr=Scourge, Sechel, and Darth Xedrix|src=<ref name="Revan" />}}
After the raid, Sechel was able to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into the separatist mainframe and discover that [[Darth Xedrix]] was working with the separatists. The group later returned to Nyriss with the evidence and Nyriss sent Lord Scourge to [[Duel on Bosthirda|eliminate]] the traitor. After a short and brutal duel, Scourge emerged victorious.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The raid first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' which was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]].
